subject: Unable to perform computations using INLA in HPC. Error from the epencency on GLIBC.

messages.author: 9dc4da17f4e4d0d4
messages.subject: Unable to perform computations using INLA in HPC. Error from the epencency on GLIBC.
parts:
Dear INLA support,

I am trying to run a multithreaded simulation task through INLA using slurm at the HPC of the University of Basel (sciCore). I have installed all the libraries and the dependencies that are normally required to perform the simulation, however I get an error regarding INLA and the BLIBC dependency.

I have raised the issue to the HPC admins, but they were unable to help me.

Quote from an admin: "I did download the tar.gz from the INLA site and the issue is that they bundle some pre-built binaries... which are not compatible with CentOS 7 (at least). I'll try to take a more detailed look to see if there is an alternative or workaround this issue."

Latest admin quote: "In my opinion, this is a bug on their side, as they should either provide static binaries or full sources to build, otherwise depending on the OS you get the issues we currently have."

Please, find attached the related scripts and a .txt file containing the error message.

Thank you in advance for your assistance!

Best,
Christos.

PS: even if I run a simple case of a simple linear model I get the same error as in error.txt

set.seed(101)

X <- rnorm(100)

epsilon <- rnorm(100)

Y <- 1.5 -2*X + epsilon

res <- inla(Y ~ 1 + X, family = "gaussian", data = data.frame(Y, X), num.threads = 1)

summary(res)
